nodes.text:
@JeromeAdamsMD Respectfully- vaccination works great but you’re always behind evolution. We should have gone with clean air 100 yrs ago. 
Pathogens can’t beat physics. Ventilation, filtration, and UV work universally, for all airborne disease. Measles, Pertussis, MDRTB, HMPV, doesn’t matter.
